title: Mujo Maula hussain mujo aaka hussain
body:
Mujo Maula hussain mujo aaka hussain
Mujo Mulula hussain mujo aaka hussain
Mera ishk bhi tu meri jaan bhi tu X 2
Mera din bhi tu imman bhi tu
Mera aan bhi tu meri sham bhi tu
Mera pir bhi tu sultan bhi tu sab waliyanja agvan bhi
Ay har momein X2
1. Ay har momein je dilje sada
Mujo mula hussain mujo aaka hussain.
Gulzar banaya X2 Ay dine khuda
<<MINI>>
Mujo maula hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tu pyasa teree pyaas bari, hai din ko tujsi aas bari, Tere naam se zinda naame khuda tere dam se hai islaam bacha
<<MINI>>
Mujo maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tu ibne baaye bismillah, tu lase kaha illallah, Ai ibne ali, ai abde khuda, Kurane khudanaize pe para
<<MINI>>
Mujo maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sardare jinaa sardaare irm, ye saara rab ye saara jag, Sab tere liye hai rab ki kasam, hai noore muhammed noore tera, Mujo maula hussain
5. Makhdum mere mere sayad, hoi khatm sitam ki tujh par had, Parsabr tera allah hu samad, allah ne dedi apni raza, Mujo maula hussain
6. Sahbaz jo hai sehwan waale, nalan ki tere rakhwale, Maidan me hai dere dale, hai laal kalandar ki bhi sadaa
<<MINI>>
Mujo maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ham sab hai matam daar tere, zindaa hai teri majlis ke liye, Ai maula tere gham ke sadke, jo maanga khuda ne ham ko diya, Mujo maula hussain
8. Majlis me teri ghazi ka alam, karta hai tere gham mein matam, Awaz ye aati hai hardam, zinda hai dilo mein dard tera, Mujo maula hussain
9. Gulzar banaya, gulzar banaya, Ei dine khuda
<<MINI>>
Mujo maula hussain
